actions.code: const x={{ json . }};function date(v){return typeof v==="string"&&/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(v)&&Number.isFinite(Date.parse(v))&&new Date(v).toISOString().slice(0,10)===v;}if(!["usage","qualification"].includes(x.jeu)||!date(x.date_debut)||!date(x.date_fin)||x.date_debut>x.date_fin)throw new Error("invalid_report_period");return {jeu:x.jeu,date_debut:x.date_debut,date_fin:x.date_fin};

const files={{ json .files }};const q={{ json .request }};if(!Array.isArray(files))throw new Error("invalid_time_listing");const entries=files.filter(f=>typeof f.path==="string"&&f.path.endsWith(".json")).map(f=>({session_id:f.path.split("/").pop().replace(/\.json$/,""),jeu:q.jeu}));if(entries.length>100)throw new Error("time_journal_limit_100_exceeded");return entries;
